expected_symptom: Rewriting with -E vsMain -remove-unused-globals -remove-unused-functions -extract-entry-uniforms leaves cbuffer cbB { ... } in the output even though its only user, psMain, was removed.
godbolt_skip: The reported surface is the rewriter (dxr.exe / IDxcRewriter2::RewriteWithOptions). Compiler Explorer's DXC compilers run dxc.exe, which rejects -remove-unused-globals and -rewrite outright (variant-dxc-rejects-rewriter-flag-main-debug.txt), so CE cannot run this repro at all.
summary: -remove-unused-globals never removes an explicit cbuffer block (nor an unused member inside one); only loose globals bound for $Globals are removal candidates. Reproduces on main 1.9.0.5433 (13730886e) via dxr.exe and on all 19 stable releases v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607 that can express the option; v1.4.1907 predates the rewriter option surface (invalid probe), so there is no regression. Structural in dxcrewriteunused.cpp, where HLSLBufferDecls go to a separate cbufferDecls list and are never added to unusedGlobals, and asserted by the lit test rewriter/remove-unused-globals.hlsl since 2020. tex3d answered the question in 2022 and converted the issue into an accepted feature request; it should stay open as an enhancement.
title: How to remove unused cbuffer?
